title: Grilling skills: start the PRD writer after map done, and share tickets cleanly between agents
story: When the last ticket closes, the agent that closed it now writes the PRD itself; before, its own tool refused to start the PRD writer and the finished map just waited. Two grilling tabs on one laptop no longer both grab the first ticket, and a ticket released at Done can be taken again straight away. In a meeting, a ticket one agent left open is not asked again by another agent, and closing a tab mid-ticket frees that ticket at once instead of locking it for the session.

checks.criterion: The agent that closes the last ticket starts the PRD writer itself
checks.steps: Use a made-up project 'garden-demo' with a map, exactly one open ticket and no fog. Open that ticket in own-time answering, answer every question, press Done.
checks.expected: The agent says the map is done and, in the same tab, writes .grillo/prd/v1.md; no 'skill cannot be invoked' refusal.

checks.criterion: Outside a meeting, two grilling agents under one login never claim the same frontier ticket
checks.steps: In 'garden-demo' with open tickets 3 and 8, start two own-time grilling agents at the same moment, neither naming a ticket. Watch which ticket each takes.
checks.expected: One takes ticket 3; the other says ticket 3 is held and takes ticket 8.

checks.criterion: When a meeting agent's tab stops, its ticket hold is cleared
checks.steps: Start a live session and open a second grilling agent. Let tab A take ticket 3, then close tab A mid-ticket. In tab B, Jump to ticket 3.
checks.expected: Tab B takes ticket 3 and is not refused as held by another agent.

checks.criterion: A ticket one agent left with questions open is not picked by another agent in the same session, and Jump still works
checks.steps: In a live session with two agents, let tab A skip past ticket 3's last question. Let tab B pick its next ticket. Then Jump tab B to ticket 3.
checks.expected: Tab B never picks ticket 3 by itself, and Jump takes it.

checks.criterion: A ticket released with questions open can be taken again straight away on the same laptop
checks.steps: Open ticket 3 in own-time answering, answer one question and press Done so it is released with questions open. Leave that tab open and take ticket 3 again from the pool.
checks.expected: The new agent claims ticket 3 and never says another agent holds it.
